name: Build Nova APK

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]

jobs:
  build-android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Prepare web files
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          mkdir -p www
          if [ -f www/index.html ]; then
            echo "Found www/index.html"
          elif [ -f www/nova.html ]; then
            echo "Found www/nova.html, copying to www/index.html"
            cp www/nova.html www/index.html
          elif [ -f index.html ]; then
            echo "Found index.html at repo root, copying to www/index.html"
            cp index.html www/index.html
          elif [ -f nova.html ]; then
            echo "Found nova.html at repo root, copying to www/index.html"
            cp nova.html www/index.html
          else
            echo "ERROR: no HTML entry point found."
            echo "Expected one of: www/index.html, www/nova.html, index.html, nova.html"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Add Android platform
        run: npx cap add android

      - name: Apply Android app icon
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq imagemagick
          SRC="assets/icon-source.png"
          test -f "$SRC"

          declare -A LEGACY=( [mdpi]=48 [hdpi]=72 [xhdpi]=96 [xxhdpi]=144 [xxxhdpi]=192 )
          declare -A FORE=( [mdpi]=108 [hdpi]=162 [xhdpi]=216 [xxhdpi]=324 [xxxhdpi]=432 )

          for density in "${!LEGACY[@]}"; do
            dir="android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-$density"
            mkdir -p "$dir"
            convert "$SRC" -resize "${LEGACY[$density]}x${LEGACY[$density]}" "$dir/ic_launcher.png"
            convert "$SRC" -resize "${LEGACY[$density]}x${LEGACY[$density]}" "$dir/ic_launcher_round.png"
            convert "$SRC" -resize "${FORE[$density]}x${FORE[$density]}" "$dir/ic_launcher_foreground.png"
          done

          mkdir -p android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26
          cat > android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml <<'XML'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <adaptive-icon xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
              <background android:drawable="@color/ic_launcher_background"/>
              <foreground android:drawable="@mipmap/ic_launcher_foreground"/>
          </adaptive-icon>
          XML
          cp android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml \
             android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher_round.xml

          python3 - <<'PY'
          import re, glob, os
          files = glob.glob('android/app/src/main/res/values/*.xml')
          pattern = re.compile(r'(<color name="ic_launcher_background">)(#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6,8})(</color>)')
          found = False
          for f in files:
              s = open(f).read()
              if pattern.search(s):
                  open(f, 'w').write(pattern.sub(r'\1#000000\3', s))
                  found = True
                  break
          if not found:
              os.makedirs('android/app/src/main/res/values', exist_ok=True)
              with open('android/app/src/main/res/values/ic_launcher_background.xml', 'w') as f:
                  f.write('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<resources>\n    <color name="ic_launcher_background">#000000</color>\n</resources>\n')
          PY

      - name: Configure Android permissions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          p = Path("android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml")
          s = p.read_text()
          marker = "</manifest>"
          perms = [
              '<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />',
              '<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO" />',
              '<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" />'
          ]
          for perm in perms:
              if perm not in s:
                  s = s.replace(marker, "    " + perm + "\n" + marker, 1)
          p.write_text(s)
          PY

      - name: Sync Nova
        run: npx cap sync android

      - name: Encrypt web assets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          KEY_HEX=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          IV_HEX=$(openssl rand -hex 16)

          mkdir -p android/app/src/main/res/raw
          openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -K "$KEY_HEX" -iv "$IV_HEX" \
            -in www/index.html \
            -out android/app/src/main/res/raw/nova_data.bin

          # Ganti index.html polos yang disalin cap sync dengan file kosong (decoy),
          # supaya extract APK biasa (unzip/apktool) tidak nemu source code aslinya.
          echo '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Nova</title></head><body></body></html>' \
            > android/app/src/main/assets/public/index.html

          KEY_JAVA=$(python3 -c "print(','.join('(byte)0x'+'$KEY_HEX'[i:i+2] for i in range(0,64,2)))")
          IV_JAVA=$(python3 -c "print(','.join('(byte)0x'+'$IV_HEX'[i:i+2] for i in range(0,32,2)))")
          echo "KEY_JAVA=$KEY_JAVA" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "IV_JAVA=$IV_JAVA" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Configure MainActivity (fullscreen + encrypted asset loading)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          MAIN=$(find android/app/src/main/java -name MainActivity.java | head -n 1)
          test -n "$MAIN"
          PACKAGE=$(grep -m1 '^package ' "$MAIN" | sed 's/package //;s/;//')
          cat > "$MAIN" <<JAVA
          package $PACKAGE;

          import android.os.Bundle;
          import android.view.View;
          import android.webkit.WebView;
          import com.getcapacitor.BridgeActivity;

          import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
          import java.io.InputStream;
          import javax.crypto.Cipher;
          import javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec;
          import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;

          public class MainActivity extends BridgeActivity {

              private static final byte[] NOVA_KEY = { $KEY_JAVA };
              private static final byte[] NOVA_IV  = { $IV_JAVA };

              @Override
              public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
                  super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
                  hideSystemUI();
                  loadEncryptedApp();
              }

              private void loadEncryptedApp() {
                  try {
                      int resId = getResources().getIdentifier("nova_data", "raw", getPackageName());
                      InputStream in = getResources().openRawResource(resId);
                      ByteArrayOutputStream buf = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
                      byte[] tmp = new byte[8192];
                      int n;
                      while ((n = in.read(tmp)) != -1) buf.write(tmp, 0, n);
                      in.close();

                      Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
                      cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE,
                              new SecretKeySpec(NOVA_KEY, "AES"),
                              new IvParameterSpec(NOVA_IV));
                      byte[] html = cipher.doFinal(buf.toByteArray());

                      WebView webView = getBridge().getWebView();
                      webView.loadDataWithBaseURL(
                              "https://localhost/",
                              new String(html, "UTF-8"),
                              "text/html",
                              "UTF-8",
                              null);
                  } catch (Exception e) {
                      e.printStackTrace();
                  }
              }

              private void hideSystemUI() {
                  getWindow().getDecorView().setSystemUiVisibility(
                      View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
                      | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN
                      | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION
                      | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN
                      | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION
                      | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE
                  );
              }

              @Override
              public void onWindowFocusChanged(boolean hasFocus) {
                  super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus);
                  if (hasFocus) hideSystemUI();
              }
          }
          JAVA

      - name: Build APK
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon

      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Nova-Lighting-APK-Fullscreen
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

      - name: Rename APK for release
        run: |
          cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk \
             android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/NovaLighting-${{ github.run_number }}.apk

      - name: Create GitHub Release with APK
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: build-${{ github.run_number }}
          name: Nova Lighting Build #${{ github.run_number }}
          files: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/NovaLighting-${{ github.run_number }}.apk

  build-windows:
    needs: build-android
    runs-on: windows-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Prepare web files
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          mkdir -p www
          if [ -f www/index.html ]; then
            echo "Found www/index.html"
          elif [ -f www/nova.html ]; then
            echo "Found www/nova.html, copying to www/index.html"
            cp www/nova.html www/index.html
          elif [ -f index.html ]; then
            echo "Found index.html at repo root, copying to www/index.html"
            cp index.html www/index.html
          elif [ -f nova.html ]; then
            echo "Found nova.html at repo root, copying to www/index.html"
            cp nova.html www/index.html
          else
            echo "ERROR: no HTML entry point found."
            echo "Expected one of: www/index.html, www/nova.html, index.html, nova.html"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Stage app files for Electron
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          mkdir -p electron/app
          cp www/index.html electron/app/index.html

      - name: Encrypt Electron app assets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          KEY_HEX=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          IV_HEX=$(openssl rand -hex 16)

          openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -K "$KEY_HEX" -iv "$IV_HEX" \
            -in electron/app/index.html \
            -out electron/app/nova_data.bin

          # Ganti index.html asli dengan decoy kosong, dan tanam key/iv ke main.js
          echo '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Nova</title></head><body></body></html>' \
            > electron/app/index.html

          sed -i "s/__NOVA_KEY_HEX__/$KEY_HEX/" electron/main.js
          sed -i "s/__NOVA_IV_HEX__/$IV_HEX/" electron/main.js

      - name: Apply Windows exe icon
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          mkdir -p electron/build
          if command -v magick >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            magick assets/icon-source.png -define icon:auto-resize=256,128,64,48,32,16 electron/build/icon.ico
          else
            convert assets/icon-source.png -define icon:auto-resize=256,128,64,48,32,16 electron/build/icon.ico
          fi

      - name: Install Electron dependencies
        working-directory: electron
        run: npm install

      - name: Build Windows portable exe
        working-directory: electron
        run: npm run dist

      - name: Rename exe for release
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          EXE=$(find electron/dist -maxdepth 1 -iname "*.exe" | head -n 1)
          test -n "$EXE"
          cp "$EXE" "electron/dist/NovaLighting-Windows-${{ github.run_number }}.exe"

      - name: Upload Windows build
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Nova-Lighting-Windows
          path: electron/dist/NovaLighting-Windows-${{ github.run_number }}.exe

      - name: Attach Windows exe to release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: build-${{ github.run_number }}
          name: Nova Lighting Build #${{ github.run_number }}
          files: electron/dist/NovaLighting-Windows-${{ github.run_number }}.exe
